pictures.name: granite_summit_unchanged
pictures.scene: a bare granite summit standing hard and unweathered against a clear sky, the near rock lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the peak and the air above it pale and cold and altogether still

pictures.name: fixed_north_star_over_a_ridge
pictures.scene: one steady star holding its place above a long dark ridge while the sky wheels around it, the near rocks lit faintly at the bottom of the frame, the night above them deep and black and immense

pictures.name: old_olive_tree_still_bearing
pictures.scene: a very old olive tree with a hollowed twisted trunk and its branches still heavy with fruit, the trunk lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the grey green canopy above it soft and dim

pictures.name: deep_bedrock_under_a_cliff
pictures.scene: the massive unbroken bedrock at the foot of a cliff carrying the whole weight above it, the near stone lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the rock wall rising above it dim and vast

pictures.name: ancient_boundary_stones_in_a_line
pictures.scene: a row of old upright boundary stones still standing evenly spaced across open pasture, the nearest stone lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the field and sky above them pale and wide

pictures.name: whole_valley_at_work_in_the_light
pictures.scene: a wide valley of streams and mills and green terraced fields all working together in clear daylight, the near water lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the slopes above it soft and quiet

pictures.name: lamp_that_kept_a_dark_night
pictures.scene: one small lamp still burning at the end of a long night with its oil almost gone, the lamp and its stand lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the dark room above it deep and cold and quiet

pictures.name: dead_tree_bleached_on_a_ridge
pictures.scene: a bare dead tree standing bleached white on an empty windswept ridge, its lower trunk lit hard and warm at the bottom of the frame, the stripped branches and pale sky above it thin and cold and blank

pictures.name: knot_tied_and_left_in_a_cord
pictures.scene: one firm knot tied in a plain cord and left there against a wooden post, the knot lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the post and wall above it dim and rough and altogether bare

pictures.name: green_leaves_breaking_from_old_wood
pictures.scene: bright green shoots breaking straight out of a thick old grey branch, the new leaves lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the old wood and the air above them dim and dark and quiet

pictures.name: plain_wax_seal_on_a_cord
pictures.scene: a round blob of red wax pressed smooth and plain onto a knotted cord and left quite unmarked, the seal lit warm and bright at the bottom of the frame, the table above it brown and dim and empty

pictures.name: still_night_over_a_quiet_courtyard
pictures.scene: a small stone courtyard lying perfectly still under a clear night sky, the paving lit faintly warm by one low lamp at the bottom of the frame, the stars and the dark air above it deep and open

pictures.name: finest_vessel_with_one_small_chip
pictures.scene: a beautifully made bowl standing on a stone shelf with one small chip broken from its rim, the bowl lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the wall above it plain and dim and quiet

pictures.name: ocean_running_past_the_horizon
pictures.scene: an enormous open ocean running away without end past a far horizon, the near swell lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the water and sky above it deep and blue and altogether limitless

lines.text: Your word, O LORD, is everlasting;
it is firmly fixed in the heavens.
Your faithfulness continues through all generations;
You established the earth, and it endures.
Your ordinances stand to this day,
for all things are servants to You.
If Your law had not been my delight,
then I would have perished in my affliction.
I will never forget Your precepts,
for by them You have revived me.
for I have sought Your precepts.
The wicked wait to destroy me,
but I will ponder Your testimonies.
I have seen a limit to all perfection,
but Your commandment is without limit.
